patch_description: Builds on the best-performing structure (repulsion pre-optimization + SLSQP polish with dmax<=1 constraint), then applies the recommended bottleneck-pair-targeted micro-polish on the top-2 candidates: displace the two points in the minimum-distance pair by small steps along their separation direction, then run a final tight SLSQP pass (maxiter 200, ftol 1e-14). Only accepts strict improvements, guaranteeing no regression. Extra structured seeds (icosahedron+Fibonacci+random) with a few extra random restarts widen the search while staying well within the timeout budget.
